pairs.evidence: lib/testing/pglite-fixture.ts:65 Each template copy is checked only by file count and total bytes before it reaches a test. No probe query runs at handoff, so a copy with the right size but unusable content first fails inside open() or a test, not at the fixture.

techniques.evidence: lib/testing/pglite-fixture.ts:65 Build-once, the fingerprinted name and stale-template reaping are done well in pglite-template.ts. The per-copy usability probe the technique requires is replaced by a size check. The template header even lists a per-file 'probe query' step that the fixture does not perform.
lib/testing/lane-partition.test.ts:50 Lanes are separate configs built from one path list. Exhaustiveness, disjointness and misfiling are asserted against the filesystem.
lib/testing/gateLadder.test.ts:78 The walk declares a floor, so an empty parse cannot pass as 'nothing missing'. revalidateParity has a similar >=6 floor.
lib/testing/moneyRouteSource.test.ts:14 The needle includes a call or assignment token that prose cannot produce. sentryScrubSource pins `beforeSend:\s*scrubFollowTelemetry` the same way.
lib/testing/pglite-fixture.ts:56 The fixture checks its own precondition and refuses any path that could resolve to the live single-connection store.
lib/testing/server-only-stub.ts:2 The pre-test import throw is handled once, in the shared resolve alias, with the reason recorded. server-boundary.test.ts covers the signal the alias removes.
lib/testing/crash-writer.mjs:26 A crash-path driver for durability.test.ts that exercises a recovery path the normal suite never reaches.

pairs.subject: test-harness
pairs.evidence: lib/testing/flake/registry.ts:16 Detection only prints candidates and keeps no label on the test, so the automatic, visible and self-removing label step of the lifecycle does not exist. CI history does not accumulate at all.

techniques.evidence: lib/testing/flake/registry.ts:16 The register is strong: named person as owner, expiry gated red, product cause refused, ceiling, published size and oldest age, muted lane. Labelling is manual, there is no stable-window release check, and the deviation is honestly stated.

lib/testing/sentinel/sentinelSource.test.ts:16 The bare identifier is already matched by the import at facts.ts:28 and the comment at :286. Removing the real call at facts.ts:293 would leave this pin green.

lib/testing/flake/sequencer.ts:21 Longest-first from measured medians with a pessimistic default is correct. But every unmeasured file gets the same median cost and is path-sorted into one contiguous block, not spread out (line 61). Slowest/mean and realized parallelism are never published, and the unmeasured count appears only under POLITICAS_LANE_DEBUG.
lib/testing/flake/registry.test.ts:100 Each register rule is fed a broken register to prove it can fire. sentinel.test.ts:7 also proves each invariant in both directions.

techniques.evidence: scripts/case-loops/apply-batch.test.ts:241 The input never reaches the decision it names: a single-row passthrough answers. The fix is to give the closed row a numeric share.
